summary: Full frontend testing of LOKAGER Module 0 launch ceremony. All 11 requested test scenarios PASS. Backend /api/health returns {status:'ok'}. No console errors and zero /api calls from the frontend during the entire ceremony flow. Countdown measured precisely: initial=30 at t=0.99s, =20 at t=11s, =5 at t=26s, celebration appeared at t=31.3s (30s countdown + ~0.7s framer-motion transition, within ±1s tolerance), coming-soon appeared at t=38.3s (celebration duration exactly 7.0s). Reload resilience verified (25 -> 24 after reload). Mobile 390x844: launch-button height=76px (>=72), fully visible, no horizontal overflow on launch/countdown/coming-soon. 404 page and back-home-button navigation work. localStorage gate works both ways: after ceremony, / shows coming-soon directly; /launch shows fresh launch-screen again after >37s.

issues: Wordmark, tagline and footer text rendered in very light gold/beige tones on ivory background produce extremely low contrast in captured screenshots — text is nearly invisible in a screenshot at neutral gamma. Likely intentional 'premium subtle' style, but worth verifying against WCAG AA (4.5:1). Recommend darkening body text (charcoal-soft) or increasing gold saturation for primary wordmarks.

action_items: Optional: review contrast of LOKAGER wordmark and body copy against ivory background for WCAG AA compliance (design decision).
critical_code_review_comments: useLaunchCeremony.js: STORAGE_KEYS.seen is written when celebration phase begins (line 49) — correct, guarantees flag is set even if user closes tab during celebration.

Ceremony.jsx uses AnimatePresence mode='wait' with 0.7s exit transition, which pushes celebration appearance from 30.0s to ~30.7s. Within spec (±1s) but timing depends on framer transitions — acceptable.
No hardcoded URLs; frontend correctly uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (none needed for Module 0). Good.
NotFoundPage uses noIndex meta — good SEO hygiene.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full ceremony e2e was verified via Playwright at https://lokager-launch.preview.emergentagent.com. Use page.evaluate("localStorage.clear()") after page.goto to reset. Timer text is Math.ceil of remaining seconds. Framer-motion transitions add ~0.7s slack between phases. Backend has only /api/health.

measured_timings.reload_resilience: before reload=25 -> after reload=24 (continued, not reset)
